critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard timeSince helper (EnhancedDashboard.jsx L89-101) correctly maps <1 min → 'Just now' green, <1 hr → 'N min ago' green, <24 hr → 'N hr ago' amber, <7 days → 'N day(s) ago' red, ≥ 7 days → 'N days ago' dark-red. Verified live pill colours in Playwright: STP fresh = green (Just now), DO stale = amber (6 hr ago). Excellent 4-level traffic-light UX.

The whole section-stp-effluent + section-do-meter Cards use `onClick={() => navigate('/water-quality')}` on the Card wrapper. Because the header (h3/CardTitle) is inside, mouse clicks anywhere in the empty area also navigate — that is the intended UX. No stopPropagation collision with inner elements.

LocationMap.jsx TYPE_STYLES already exposes wq_stp (orange-red #c2410c) and do_meter (sky-blue #0284c7). The legend uses `presentTypes` which is derived from actually-rendered instrument_type values — good, prevents dead legend chips when the client has no such device.
